_comment: Malaysia — Customs Duties Order 2025, P.U. (A) 384, in force 1 November 2025. TWO sources, both needed. Structure, descriptions and the import/export duties come from the gazette PDF (1,466 pages), because the ezHS portal's table is sorted rather than in document order and so cannot carry the dash-depth hierarchy. Sales tax, excise and cess come from the portal (https://ezhs.customs.gov.my/public-tariff), joined by 10-digit code; the portal has no duplicate codes, so the join is exact. Tariff-rate-quota figures come from Appendix B of the gazette, which the portal leaves blank. Codes are 4/6/8/10 digits and the 8-digit ones are internal nodes, not truncations. Neither source is downloadable on a schedule, so there is no adapter: both are fetched by hand and scripts/hts_automation/parse_my_pdk.py converts them.
_comment_ftas: The portal also serves 19 preferential schedules (ATIGA, ACFTA, AHKFTA, MPCEPA, AKFTA, AJCEP, AANZFTA, AINDFTA, MNZFTA, MICECA, D8PTA, MCFTA, MAFTA, MTFTA, RCEP, CPTPP, TPS-OIC, MY-UAE-CEPA) at the same URL shape with a per-scheme km key. Out of scope here: a preferential rate is per-origin and belongs in the duty-rates surface, not in the Explorer's three rate columns.
_comment_verify: No verify thresholds: those compare a revision against its predecessor and this is the first edition captured.
name: Malaysia

manual_revision._comment: The Customs Duties Order is the edition; an amendment order would be rev_num 2 of the same year.
